The Community Living Center Registered Nurse is responsible for providing competent, evidence-based care to residents with oversight of licensed vocational nurses/nursing assistants as appropriate to the setting.

The Registered Nurse will assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and enhance outcomes utilization.

Duties include but are not limited to: Assumes responsibility for the coordination of care focused on patient education, self-management, and customer satisfaction throughout the continuum of care. Administers medications and procedures per established policies and guidelines.

Influences care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team. Core elements of performance include knowledge and active participation in the unit/program level quality improvement process and initiatives as well as customer service programs.

Responsible and accountable for individual nursing practice and determines the appropriate delegation of tasks consistent with the nurse's obligation to provide optimal care. The focus is on individual growth and development in practice with increased levels of self-direction. Ability to formulate a plan of care based on nursing assessments.

Seeks guidance in how to improve care provided to residents and families. Brings principles and theory with limited application of critical thinking skills. Seeks documentation guidance from the Minimum Data Set (MDS) coordinator to ensure accuracy of the Resource Utilization Group (RUG) score.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: Full-Time.

Days and Evenings. Every other weekend/holiday rotations. Telework: This position is not telework eligible. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. The Assistant Nurse Manager (ANM) supports the Nurse Manager (NM) with supervisory duties and responsibility and accountability for the 24/7 operation of their designated units. They provide coverage for other ANMs as needed.

The ANM has responsibility and accountability for the direction and supervision of specific orientation, training, development of staff, and evaluation of individual staff performance. They function as a role model, educator, practitioner, and supervisor providing leadership to the team.

They influence care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team to remove barriers and implement new evidence-based cutting-edge programs/processes. The ANM is expected to deliver patient care based on the needs of the unit. The ANM engages in professional organizations to enhance leadership and career growth.

They adhere to ethical principles in decision-making, fostering accountability at personal, organizational, and staff levels. They equip staff with tools for culturally competent care and promotes a culture of accountability for high-quality, cost-effective outcomes.

They cultivate alliances across the care continuum, building trust through active listening, engagement, and emotional intelligence. The ANM contributes to the development of care delivery models and environmental design, ensuring evidence-based, accessible, affordable, and equitable patient care.

Ensures compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards. Aligns nursing/clinical objectives with organizational strategic outcomes, participating in strategy planning and execution. They promote an inclusive workplace valuing diversity to achieve the organizations vision and mission.

The ANM maintains knowledge and ensures compliance with all regulatory and accreditation standards, Directives, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOP).

Physical Requirements: It is VA policy to ensure that all selected applicants and employed personnel are physically, mentally and emotionally fit to perform the duties of the position to which assigned.

A pre-placement physical examination is required for all fulltime, part-time and intermittent employees identified by VA Directive and Handbook 5019. The pre-placement physical examination shall be completed prior to appointment to determine the physical and mental fitness for candidates for appointment in VA.

The examination will be concerned with the mental and physical ability of the applicant to satisfactorily perform the duties of the proposed assignment and will include requisite laboratory and other screening as required by Federal regulatory agencies.

This position requires visual acuity, keen hearing, clear distinctive speech, and manual dexterity. This position requires potentially long periods of continued walking, standing, stooping, sitting, bending, pulling, and pushing. This position requires that you are able to lift at least 50 lbs. Transferring patients and objects may be required.

The incumbent may be exposed to infected patients and contaminated materials and may be required to don protective clothing in isolation situations or operative/invasive procedures. The incumbent may occasionally be exposed to patients who are combative secondary to delirium, dementia, or psychiatric disorders.

The incumbent must be a mature, flexible, sensible individual capable of working effectively in stressful situations, able to shift priorities based on organizational needs. Must complete annual Employee Health requirements, such as annual Influenza vaccination, TB screening or testing, as a condition of employment.

Major Duties: Clinical Operations & Patient Safety - Ensures continuous monitoring and safety checks in accordance with suicidal and homicidal risk protocols, contraband prevention procedures, elopement policies, and mental health observation standards. - Oversees implementation of trauma-informed care, de-escalation strategies, and approved behavioral management interventions (e.g., CPI/PMDB-trained approaches). - Ensures staff competency in psychiatric emergency response, including Code Green/behavioral rapid response procedures, and safe application of seclusion/restraint in strict accordance with regulatory standards. - Monitors trends in behavioral incidents and leads corrective action plans to improve unit safety.

Staff Supervision & Development - Directs psychiatric nursing staff in performing mental status assessments, behavior documentation, therapeutic communication, medication administration, and withdrawal monitoring. - Ensures staff maintain competency in suicide prevention, recovery model principles, substance use disorder protocols, and management of acute psychiatric symptoms. - Provides real-time coaching during high-acuity events (e.g., escalation, aggressive behaviors, rapid clinical deterioration).

Interdisciplinary Collaboration - Actively participates in and coordinates daily treatment team rounds, reviewing each Veteran's psychiatric symptoms, progress, barriers to discharge, and recovery goals. - Partners closely with psychiatry providers on medication changes, behavioral plans, and crisis interventions. - Engages social work on discharge planning, safety planning, and coordination with outpatient MH programs such as PRRC, HUD-VASH, and SUD services.

Quality & Compliance - Ensures adherence to Joint Commission Behavioral Health standards, VA mental health policies, seclusion/restraint regulations, and documentation requirements for high-risk patients. - Leads performance improvement projects specific to inpatient psychiatry such as falls in MH populations, seclusion/restraint reduction, suicide risk management, and aggression mitigation. - Facilitates Root Cause Analyses and safety huddles related to psychiatric care events.

Environment of Care - Maintains a ligature-resistant environment; ensures staff reporting, maintenance follow-up, and environmental rounds are completed timely. - Collaborates with engineering and MH leadership on safety enhancements and compliance with ligature-risk mitigation plans.

Veteran-Centered Mental Health Care - Ensures individualized therapeutic interventions, including psychoeducation, coping skills development, crisis stabilization, and recovery planning. - Promotes Veteran engagement in group therapies, treatment planning, and self-management activities. - Monitors patient experience feedback specific to mental health care (e.g., perceptions of safety, therapeutic engagement, staff responsiveness).

Mammern liegt malerisch am Untersee im Kanton Thurgau und besticht durch seine naturnahe Lage am Bodensee. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung durch die Bahnverbindung nach Amriswil und die nahegelegene Autobahn. Die Region ist als Arbeitsort attraktiv, da Sie ländliche Ruhe mit beruflichen Perspektiven verbinden und das malerische Uferambiente Ihre Lebensqualität bereichert.
**Einsatzort:** Mammern und Umgebung
**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Als **dipl. Pflegefachfrau/mann FH 80-100%** trägst du maßgeblich zur Qualität und Weiterentwicklung der Patientenversorgung bei.
Unser **Personalbüro für Pflege in Mammern** vermittelt Fachkräfte für **offene Stellen für Pflege in Mammern**, sei es in Akutspitälern, Langzeitpflegeeinrichtungen oder in der Spitex. Nutze dein Fachwissen, um die Pflege auf höchstem Niveau zu gestalten und werde zur Pflegefachfrau/mann FH, die jeder kennt.
**Deine Aufgaben:**
· Durchführung und Überwachung der medizinischen und pflegerischen Versorgung von Patienten in verschiedenen Fachbereichen.
· Sicherstellung einer professionellen und patientenorientierten Betreuung unter Berücksichtigung individueller Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen an eine Pflegefachfrau/mann FH.
· Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, Therapeuten und weiteren Fachkräften zur optimalen Patientenversorgung.
· Beratung und Unterstützung von Patienten und Angehörigen im Gesundheits- und Pflegeprozess. Besonders als Pflegefachfrau/mann FH ist dies wichtig.
· Dokumentation der Pflegeleistungen zur kontinuierlichen Qualitätsverbesserung und Sicherstellung der Behandlungserfolge.
· Implementierung von neuen Pflegestandards und Weiterentwicklung der internen Prozesse zur Optimierung der Pflegequalität.
**Dein Profil:**
· Abgeschlossenes Studium als **Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/mann FH oder Bachelor of Science in Pflege**.
· Erfahrung in Akutpflege, Langzeitpflege oder Spitex von Vorteil.
· Fähigkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und komplexe Pflegeprozesse zu koordinieren, wie es von einer Pflegefachfrau/mann FH erwartet wird.
· Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Engagement und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit.
· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
**Unser Angebot:**
· **Attraktive offene Stellen für Pflege in Mammern 80-100%** mit langfristiger Perspektive und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
· **Flexible Temporärstellen für Pflege in Mammern**, falls du eine individuelle Arbeitsgestaltung bevorzugst oder als Pflegefachfrau/mann FH neue Herausforderungen suchst.
· **Individuelle Karriereberatung durch unser Personalbüro für Pflege in Mammern, um die optimale Stelle für dich zu finden.**
· **Gezielte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur Spezialisierung und Karriereentwicklung.**
· **Faire Vergütung, moderne Arbeitsstrukturen und ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.**

The nurse will assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and outcomes utilization consultation. Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others.

Evaluates patients in the CLC upon admission to Restorative Care Program and monthly thereafter to determine the potential for the program. Responsible for screening Veterans and conducting initial assessment prior to admission to the Restorative Care Program.

Outline and implement measurable functional goals for Veterans to reach their highest level of function and maximize their independence.

Evaluates patient progress toward their goals monthly and institutes changes in therapy, goals, and activity when necessary.

Completes the restorative nursing sections of the Minimum Data Set (MOS), specifically the observation period, quarterly reassessments, and significant changes in care. Monitors assignments to ensure they are appropriate with the level of education and training demonstrated of restorative personnel.

Acts as a role model, mentor, and coach to the program's staff. Provides developmental opportunities for program staff to acquire clinical restorative nursing skills and expertise. Accountable to develop and implement educational programs and/or in-services to keep nursing staff current in restorative care practice and documented competencies.

Implements strategies and programs for restorative nursing care that is consistent with the facilities mission, vision, policies, goals, and objectives. Responsible for the outcomes of the patient/client as measured by the MOS quality indicators, which is shared with the multidisciplinary team.

Provides peers with informal constructive feedback for improvement. Fosters a safe and supportive environment conducive to the professional development of healthcare professionals. Supports colleagues through knowledge sharing to provide safe, quality nursing care. Questions clinical practices for the purpose of providing evidence-based care.

## Tâches ##
Les infirmiers HF portent la responsabilité professionnelle tout au long du processus de soins. Ils sont responsables de la planification, de l-exécution, de la délégation et du contrôle des mesures de soins. Après avoir recueilli des informations détaillées sur les besoins en soins et les besoins des patients, ils élaborent un concept de soins.

En équipe, ils mettent en œuvre les mesures de soins et en contrôlent l-effet et le succès. Ils observent attentivement l-évolution de la maladie et le processus de guérison.

Dans la documentation des soins, ils consignent quotidiennement les développements les plus récents et partagent leurs connaissances lors des rapports de service et des visites médicales.

Les infirmiers HF sont régulièrement confrontés à des situations exigeantes dans leur travail : ils assistent des patientes et patients dans des états physiques et psychiques variés et accompagnent les personnes dans toutes les situations de la vie.

ou
* Certificat de maturité spécialisée ou maturité gymnasiale
